title: Fix price()
prompt: In lib/format.js, the function `price` has a bug. price(cents) must format cents as dollars with exactly two decimals, so price(1250) is "$12.50" and price(500) is "$5.00". Fix that function. Do not change the other functions and do not add files.

title: Fix slug()
prompt: In lib/format.js, the function `slug` has a bug. slug(text) must lower-case the text, turn each run of characters that are not letters or digits into one dash, and leave no dash at either end, so slug("Hello, World!") is "hello-world". Fix that function. Do not change the other functions and do not add files.

title: Fix initials()
prompt: In lib/format.js, the function `initials` has a bug. initials(name) must return the first letter of each word in upper case, whatever the spacing, so initials("ada  lovelace") is "AL". Fix that function. Do not change the other functions and do not add files.

title: Fix truncate()
prompt: In lib/format.js, the function `truncate` has a bug. truncate(text, max) must return at most max characters, ending in "…" when the text was cut, so truncate("abcdefgh", 5) is "abcd…". Fix that function. Do not change the other functions and do not add files.

title: Fix clock()
prompt: In lib/format.js, the function `clock` has a bug. clock(hours, minutes) must return both numbers with two digits, so clock(7, 5) is "07:05". Fix that function. Do not change the other functions and do not add files.
